title: Updating an EnumMap merges the values already owned by the caller
summary: Updating the EnumMap modified the externally held A value. Reading the serialized bean back showed that changing C’s initial state affected only C.

change.description: Updating an existing EnumMap now passes an existing value into deserialization when content merging is enabled. Fresh maps and explicitly nonmergeable values continue to use replacement semantics.

notes: Both builds use the timestamped Jackson Core 3.4.0 and annotations 2.24 snapshots listed in runtime.json.
